description: Schedule a message to yourself in this chat, sent once at a later time: to check something again, remind the user, or go on with a task later ("check the price again tomorrow at 9"). At its time Buddy sends it into this chat as a new message to you, also with the phone locked, and you work as usual. The user sees it above the chat and can cancel it. For something every day, tell the user about Chat options > Schedule instead.

at.description: Or at this time, the phone's: "2026-10-28 09:00", or "09:00" for the next one

message.description: What to do then, as a message to yourself with everything you'll need

quiet.description: For a check you'll run then ("tell me if the price drops"): you may end that run without notifying the user when there's no news

remind.description: A plain reminder for the user ("remind me at 6 to call mom"): at that time Buddy shows the message to them as a notification and in this chat, without running you, so it uses none of their plan. The message is then for the user.

name: schedule_message
